outcome: Neonatal complications (respiratory distress, feeding problems, hypothermia, seizures)
cohort: 39,258 term singleton deliveries at Mater Mothers' Hospital in Brisbane, Australia between January 2007 and December 2015
finding: Low and intermediate five-minute Apgar scores were strongly associated with mode of birth and poorer neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Emergency operative birth (cesarean and instrumental) conveyed a higher risk of low and intermediate Apgar scores and poorer neonatal outcomes.
